name: Cercs (Spain)
description: Dark green field with a light blue triangle at the fly and a white couched chevron between them issuing from the fly corners to the middle of the flag, with two crossed yellow miners' hammers in the upper hoist.
history: The flag was approved by the municipal council on 8 October 2002 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 27 November 2002; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, dark green, with a light blue triangle at the fly and a white couched chevron between the two parts, issuing from the upper and lower fly corners with its point at the middle of the cloth.

features.role: triangle with its base along the fly edge
couched chevron 2/9 of the length thick with its point at the middle of the flag
